questions.title: Circle Area via Pi Macro
questions.description:
Use #define to declare PI as the integer 3. Read an integer radius r, then compute and print the integer area as PI * r * r.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer r.

Output Format:
The integer area PI * r * r.

Constraints:
1 <= r <= 1000

questions.title: Hello via stdio Include
questions.description:
Use #include <stdio.h> to bring in printf. Read a single integer n and print "Hello <n>".

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "Hello <n>".

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Greeting via Ifdef Selection
questions.description:
Use #ifdef and #if to choose a greeting macro. With MODE defined as 2, the greeting is "Hi". Read an integer n, then print "<greeting> <n>".

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "Hi <n>".

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Square via Macro Function
questions.description:
Define a macro function SQUARE(x) that computes ((x) * (x)). Read an integer n, then print SQUARE(n).

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The square of n.

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Print Source Line Number
questions.description:
Use the predefined macro __LINE__ to print the source line number where it appears. Read an integer n (ignored in the output), then print the line number on its own line. (The line number is fixed by the source layout.)

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The line number where __LINE__ is used.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Echo Input with Pragma Once
questions.description:
Use #pragma once at the top of the source file. Read an integer n and print it back unchanged.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The same integer n.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Bank Interest via Rate Macro
questions.description:
A bank defines INTEREST_RATE as 5 (percent). Read a principal P (integer), compute the integer interest as P * INTEREST_RATE / 100, and print it.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer P.

Output Format:
The integer interest.

Constraints:
1 <= P <= 10^6

questions.title: Greet User via stdio
questions.description:
A program uses #include <stdio.h> to greet the user. Read a single-word name (no spaces) and print "Hello, <name>!".

Input Format:
A single line containing one word (the name).

Output Format:
The string "Hello, <name>!".

Constraints:
1 <= name length <= 99, alphabetic characters only

questions.title: Build Mode Banner via Ifdef
questions.description:
A build system uses #ifdef EXTERNAL_API to switch the build banner. In this build EXTERNAL_API is NOT defined, so the banner is "BUILTIN <n>". Read an integer n, then print the banner.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "BUILTIN <n>".

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Max of Two via Macro Function
questions.description:
A math utility defines a macro MAX(a, b). Read two integers a and b, then print the maximum using MAX(a, b).

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated integers.

Output Format:
The maximum of a and b.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= a, b <= 10^9

questions.title: Temperature State via Macros
questions.description:
A weather tool uses #define FREEZING_POINT 0 and #define BOILING_POINT 100. Read an integer temperature t. Print "FREEZING" if t < FREEZING_POINT, "BOILING" if t > BOILING_POINT, else "NORMAL".

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer t.

Output Format:
One of "FREEZING", "BOILING", or "NORMAL".

Constraints:
-1000 <= t <= 1000

questions.title: Alpha Check via ctype Include
questions.description:
A program includes both <stdio.h> and <ctype.h>. Read a single character, then print 'Y' if it is alphabetic, 'N' otherwise.

Input Format:
A single line containing one character (may be preceded by whitespace).

Output Format:
A single character 'Y' or 'N' on its own line.

Constraints:
The input is a single ASCII character.
questions.inputconstrains: Input is a single ASCII character

questions.title: Version Banner via Ifdef Ladder
questions.description:
A library uses an #ifdef/#else ladder with nested #ifdef to pick a version banner. With VERSION defined as 3, the banner is "Stable". Read an integer n, then print "<banner> <n>".

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "Stable <n>".

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Absolute Value via ABS Macro
questions.description:
A math library defines a macro ABS(x) that returns the absolute value. Read an integer n, then print ABS(n).

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The absolute value of n.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Debug Line Tag via Predefined Macro
questions.description:
A debugging tool tags output with the current source line number (via __LINE__). Read an integer n, then print "Line <line> Value <n>". The line number is determined by the source layout.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "Line <line> Value <n>" where <line> is the line number where __LINE__ is used.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Packed Struct Size via Pragma
questions.description:
A library uses #pragma pack(push, 1) to control struct alignment. Define a struct Packed with a char and an int. Read an integer n, then print "<n> <sizeof>" where <sizeof> is the byte size of the packed struct.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The string "<n> <sizeof>" (sizeof is the byte size of struct Packed).

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Weight via Gravity Macro
questions.description:
A physics simulation uses #define GRAVITY 981 (representing 9.81 m/s^2 scaled by 100 for integer math). Read a mass m (kg), then compute weight = m * GRAVITY / 100 (integer division).

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer m (mass in kg).

Output Format:
The integer weight.

Constraints:
1 <= m <= 10^6

questions.title: Letter Count via Includes
questions.description:
A text analysis tool includes <stdio.h>, <string.h>, and <ctype.h>. Read a single-line string and count the number of alphabetic characters using isalpha.

Input Format:
A single line containing the input string.

Output Format:
The count of alphabetic characters.

Constraints:
1 <= |s| <= 1000

questions.title: Bonus Tier via Nested Ifdef
questions.description:
A feature-flag system uses nested #ifdef/#else to pick a bonus tier. PRO_FEATURE is NOT defined; BASIC_FEATURE IS defined; the bonus is 10. Read an integer n, then print n + BONUS.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The value n + 10.

Constraints:
-10^9 <= n <= 10^9

questions.title: Shape Area via Macro Functions
questions.description:
A geometry library defines macros AREA_RECT(w, h) and AREA_CIRCLE(r) (using PI scaled to 314, then divided by 100 for integer math). Read a shape code (1 = rectangle, 2 = circle) followed by its dimensions, then print the area.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer shape (1 or 2).
Line 2: if shape is 1, two integers w and h; if shape is 2, one integer r.

Output Format:
The area as an integer.

Constraints:
shape in {1, 2}, 1 <= w, h, r <= 1000
